items.source:
Regular and XMl properties files are supported: for example, "messages" will find
a "messages.properties", "messages_en.properties" etc arrangement as well
as "messages.xml", "messages_en.xml" etc.
items.translation: 支持常规和 XML 属性文件：例如，"messages"将查找"messages.properties"、"messages_en.properties"等排列方式，以及"messages.xml"、"messages_en.xml"等。

items.source: in favor of getDefaultLocale()
items.translation: 支持使用getDefaultLocale()。

items.source: Note that depending on your ClassLoader, expiration might not work reliably since the ClassLoader may hold on to a cached version of the bundle file. Prefer ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource over ResourceBundleMessageSource in such a scenario, in combination with a non-classpath location.
items.translation: 请注意，根据您使用的 ClassLoader，过期功能可能无法可靠工作，因为 ClassLoader 可能会保留 bundle 文件的缓存版本。 在这种情况下，请优先使用 ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource 而不是 ResourceBundleMessageSource，并配合非 classpath 位置使用。

items.source: Note: In contrast to addBasenames(String...), this replaces existing entries with the given names and can therefore also be used to reset the configuration.
items.translation: 注意：与addBasenames(String...)不同，此方法会用给定的名称替换现有条目，因此也可用于重置配置。

items.source: The effective default is the java.util.Properties default encoding: ISO-8859-1. A null value indicates the platform default encoding.
items.translation: 有效默认值是 `java.util.Properties` 的默认编码：ISO-8859-1。`null` 值表示平台默认编码。

items.source: Default is to fall back to the system Locale. You may override this with a locally specified default Locale here, or enforce no fallback locale at all through disabling "fallbackToSystemLocale".
items.translation: 默认情况下会回退到系统 Locale。您可以在此处通过指定本地默认 Locale 来覆盖此设置，或者通过禁用"fallbackToSystemLocale"来完全禁止回退 Locale。

items.source: The associated resource bundles will be checked sequentially when resolving a message code. Note that message definitions in a previous resource bundle will override ones in a later bundle, due to the sequential lookup.
items.translation: 在解析消息代码时，将按顺序检查关联的资源包。请注意，由于是按顺序查找，之前资源包中的消息定义将覆盖后续资源包中的定义。

items.source: Falling back to the system Locale is the default behavior of java.util.ResourceBundle. However, this is often not desirable in an application server environment, where the system Locale is not relevant to the application at all: set this flag to "false" in such a scenario.
items.translation: 回退到系统 Locale 是java.util.ResourceBundle的默认行为。然而，在应用服务器环境中，这通常并不可取，因为系统 Locale 与该应用程序完全无关：在此类场景中，请将此标志设置为"false"。

items.source:
Note: If a given basename already exists, the position of its entry
will remain as in the original set. New entries will be added at the
end of the list, to be searched after existing basenames.
items.translation: 注意：如果给定的 basename 已存在，其条目位置将保持在原始集合中。新条目将添加到列表末尾，以便在现有 basename 之后进行搜索。

items.source: Calling code may introspect this set as well as add or remove entries.
items.translation: 调用代码也可以对此集合进行内省，并添加或删除条目。

items.source: Only applies to classic properties files, not to XML files.
items.translation: 仅适用于经典属性文件，不适用于 XML 文件。

items.source:
Set the number of milliseconds to cache loaded properties files. Note that it is common to set seconds instead: setCacheSeconds(int).
  • Default is "-1", indicating to cache forever (matching the default behavior of java.util.ResourceBundle). Note that this constant follows Spring conventions, not ResourceBundle.Control.getTimeToLive(String, Locale).
  • A positive number will cache loaded properties files for the given number of milliseconds. This is essentially the interval between refresh checks. Note that a refresh attempt will first check the last-modified timestamp of the file before actually reloading it; so if files don't change, this interval can be set rather low, as refresh attempts will not actually reload.
  • A value of "0" will check the last-modified timestamp of the file on every message access. Do not use this in a production environment!
items.translation:
设置缓存已加载属性文件的毫秒数。 注意，通常设置的是秒：setCacheSeconds(int)。
  • 默认值为 "-1"，表示永久缓存（与 java.util.ResourceBundle 的默认行为一致）。请注意，此常量遵循 Spring 约定，而非 ResourceBundle.Control.getTimeToLive(String, Locale)。
  • 正数将缓存已加载的属性文件，时长为指定的毫秒数。这本质上是刷新检查之间的间隔。请注意，刷新尝试会首先检查文件的最后修改时间戳，然后再实际重新加载；因此，如果文件未更改，可以将此间隔设置得相当低，因为刷新尝试实际上不会重新加载。
  • 值为 "0" 将在每次消息访问时检查文件的最后修改时间戳。请勿在生产环境中使用此选项！

items.source: Abstract base class for MessageSource implementations based on resource bundle conventions, such as ResourceBundleMessageSource and ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource. Provides common configuration methods and corresponding semantic definitions.
items.translation: 基于资源包约定（如ResourceBundleMessageSource和ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource）的`MessageSource`实现类的抽象基类。提供通用的配置方法和相应的语义定义。

items.source: Determine a default Locale to fall back to: either a locally specified default Locale or the system Locale, or null for no fallback locale at all.
items.translation: 确定要回退的默认区域设置：可以是本地指定的默认区域设置、系统区域设置，或完全不使用回退区域设置的 `null`。

items.source: Return the number of milliseconds to cache loaded properties files.
items.translation: 返回缓存已加载属性文件的毫秒数。

items.source: Return the default charset to use for parsing properties files, if any.
items.translation: 返回用于解析属性文件的默认字符集（如果有）。

items.source:
Return whether to fall back to the system Locale if no files for a specific
Locale have been found.
items.translation: 返回是否在没有找到特定 Locale 的文件时回退到系统 Locale。

items.source: Default is "-1", indicating to cache forever (matching the default behavior of java.util.ResourceBundle). Note that this constant follows Spring conventions, not ResourceBundle.Control.getTimeToLive(String, Locale).
items.translation: 默认为 "-1"，表示永久缓存（与 java.util.ResourceBundle 的默认行为一致）。请注意，此常量遵循 Spring 约定，而非 ResourceBundle.Control.getTimeToLive(String, Locale)。

items.source: A value of "0" will check the last-modified timestamp of the file on every message access. Do not use this in a production environment!
items.translation: 值为 "0" 将检查每次消息访问时文件的最后修改时间戳。请勿在生产环境中使用此设置！

items.source: basename - the single basename
items.translation: basename - 单个基本名称

items.source: basenames - an array of basenames
items.translation: basenames - 一个基名数组

items.source: defaultEncoding - the default charset
items.translation: defaultEncoding - 默认字符集

items.source:
A positive number will cache loaded properties files for the given
number of seconds. This is essentially the interval between refresh checks.
Note that a refresh attempt will first check the last-modified timestamp
of the file before actually reloading it; so if files don't change, this
interval can be set rather low, as refresh attempts will not actually reload.
items.translation: 正数将缓存加载的属性文件，持续时间为指定的秒数。这本质上是刷新检查之间的间隔。请注意，刷新尝试会首先检查文件的最后修改时间戳，然后再实际重新加载；因此，如果文件未发生变化，可以将此间隔设置得相当低，因为刷新尝试实际上不会重新加载。

items.source: Return this MessageSource's basename set, containing entries in the order of registration.
items.translation: 返回此MessageSource的基名集，其中包含按注册顺序排列的条目。

items.source: Add the specified basenames to the existing basename configuration.
items.translation: 将指定的基文件名添加到现有的基文件名配置中。

items.source:
Set a single basename, following the basic ResourceBundle convention
of not specifying file extension or language codes.
items.translation: 设置单个基本名称，遵循基本资源包约定，即不指定文件扩展名或语言代码。

items.source:
Set an array of basenames, each following the basic ResourceBundle convention
of not specifying file extension or language codes.
items.translation: 设置一个基名数组，每个基名遵循基本资源包约定，即不指定文件扩展名或语言代码。

items.source: Set the number of milliseconds to cache loaded properties files.
items.translation: 设置缓存已加载属性文件的毫秒数。

items.source: Set the number of seconds to cache loaded properties files.
items.translation: 设置缓存已加载属性文件的秒数。

items.source: Set the default charset to use for parsing properties files.
items.translation: 将默认字符集设置为用于解析属性文件的字符集。

items.source:
Specify a default Locale to fall back to, as an alternative to falling back
to the system Locale.
items.translation: 指定一个默认 Locale 作为回退选项，而不是回退到系统 Locale。

items.source:
Set whether to fall back to the system Locale if no files for a specific
Locale have been found.
items.translation: 设置是否在未找到特定 Locale 的文件时回退到系统 Locale。
